title: Weekly classic-pivot × H4 zone geometry — spacing/ATR robustness

dataset.analysis_timeframe: Weekly classic pivots / H4 terminal and wick observations

hypotheses.market_question: Does the Weekly-pivot × H4 terminal/wick relationship become materially stronger under a principled pivot-zone geometry that accounts for adjacent pivot spacing and/or lagged H4 ATR?
hypotheses.null: None of the seven preregistered geometries yields a robust structural terminal effect and pivot-specific wick interaction after full-family correction and validation.
hypotheses.alternative: At least one preregistered spacing or spacing-plus-ATR geometry yields a temporally and cross-pair robust Weekly/H4 terminal zone and wick interaction.
hypotheses.mechanism: A fixed fraction of weekly pivot spacing can represent different H4 noise scales; volatility-aware capping may reduce dilution while structural spacing prevents zone overlap.

method.primary_endpoint: For each geometry, Weekly/H4 wick difference-in-differences: (core strong - core weak) - (equal-width matched outer strong - matched outer weak).
method.economic_effect_size: Percentage-point pivot-specific wick interaction; structural core-minus-matched-outer terminal effect is a required companion endpoint.
method.event_definition: Classic prior-week NY17 floor pivots S3-R3; H4 high/low observations; terminal label from pivot-blind ATR24 lagged one H4 bar and 0.75 ATR directional change with strictly later-bar confirmation; strong wick >=30%, weak <10%.
controls: equal-width outer band at 50% nearest-pivot corridor edge

inference.multiple_testing: separate Holm correction across seven structural effects and seven wick interactions

execution.same_bar_policy: candidate endpoint cannot self-confirm on same H4 candle

holdout.prior_exposure: Weekly/H4 outcomes in this study are 2015-2021 only. The same 2022-2025 calendar window has now been opened separately for the Daily/H1 wick-confirmation question, but Weekly/H4 outcomes were not inspected.

provenance.notes: Seven geometries frozen before any new weekly geometry outcome calculation. Two preliminary runs were invalidated under the preregistered deterministic SP20 reference-reproduction gate; final admissible run reproduces the parent SP20 reference exactly. 2022-2025 Weekly/H4 outcomes remained uninspected.
